calls.title: Home Page Updates
calls.summary: The discussion focused on improving the visibility of new feature announcements within the app, as current updates are often missed by users due to hidden sections and maintenance gaps. Kari Kay highlighted that the existing 'get started' section is underutilized and not effectively maintained. A proposal was made by Kari to repurpose personalized feature spots to showcase the latest releases, receiving approval from Ryan Feigenbaum as a low-effort fix. Several points concerning design and content maintenance arose, indicating a need for consistent updates and clear ownership. Both Kari and Ryan noted the importance of assessing user behavior data to guide future changes without rushing into a redesign. Immediate actions include fixing broken links and enhancing visibility for existing updates, while major changes are to be deferred until more data is available.
calls.keywords: homepage updates, new features notification, blog posts, user engagement, feature visibility, design suggestions

calls.title: Home Page Updates
calls.summary: The discussion centered around enhancing user awareness of new app features by addressing the hidden nature of current notifications. Ashley suggested implementing an in-app notification system, while Ryan proposed a 'What's New' section to display blog posts and release notes prominently on the homepage. Kari pointed out that the existing feature content is often buried and outdated. The team noted the homepage's cluttered layout, mixing diverse user journey points, which causes confusion; suggestions included repositioning feature notifications for better visibility. User engagement data on homepage interactions is lacking, making it difficult to make informed decisions. An emphasis was placed on quick, short-term fixes, like correcting 404 errors, while major redesigns were postponed until further data analysis is conducted.
calls.keywords: homepage updates, feature notifications, user engagement, blog posts, release announcements, visual hierarchy
